explicit_ACs: Users can log in using a manual login form with the following fields: — Email: Required. Must be a valid email format. — Error if empty: "Email is required"
Users can log in using a manual login form with the following fields: — Email: Required. Must be a valid email format. — Error if invalid: "Invalid email address"
Users can log in using a manual login form with the following fields: — Password: Required. Masked input. — Error if empty: "Password is required"
Users can log in using a manual login form with the following fields: — Log In Button: Validates all fields and authenticates the user. On successful login, redirects to the Home Screen.
There is a recovery path for users who forget their password: — Forget Password Link: Clicking the text "Forget Password?" redirects the user to the password recovery flow/page.
Users attempting to log in with invalid credentials should receive an error message: — If email/password combination is incorrect, display: "Invalid email or password"
Users with unregistered accounts should receive an error message: — If the email is not associated with an account, display: "No account found with this email"
There is a path for users who do not yet have an account: — Sign Up Link: Navigates users to the registration page.
implicit_ACs: The login screen displays the Exclusive platform logo prominently above the login form.
The login screen displays a prominent heading such as 'Log In' or 'Sign In' at the top of the form.
The login screen displays a subheading or introductory line beneath the main heading, such as 'Enter your details below'.
The email input field is accompanied by a visible label reading 'Email' or 'Email Address' positioned above or adjacent to the field.
The password input field is accompanied by a visible label reading 'Password' positioned above or adjacent to the field.
The password input field includes a show/hide toggle icon (e.g. an eye icon) that allows the user to reveal or conceal the entered password.
The login screen displays a descriptive prompt text adjacent to the Sign Up link, such as 'Don't have an account?' to contextualise the registration path.

all_discrepancies.element_name: Sign Up Link with contextual prompt
all_discrepancies.description: There is no 'Don't have an account?' prompt text adjacent to or near a Sign Up link within the login form area.
all_discrepancies.violated_criterion: The login screen displays a descriptive prompt text adjacent to the Sign Up link, such as 'Don't have an account?' to contextualise the registration path.
all_discrepancies.feedback: The 'Sign Up Link with contextual prompt' is missing from the design at form body. This element is required by AC-01 and was not found in 5 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.

all_discrepancies.description: The password input field does not display any show/hide eye icon toggle to allow users to reveal or conceal their entered password.
all_discrepancies.violated_criterion: The password input field includes a show/hide toggle icon (e.g. an eye icon) that allows the user to reveal or conceal the entered password.
all_discrepancies.feedback: The 'Password show/hide toggle icon' is missing from the design at form body. This element is required by AC-02 and was not found in 5 out of 5 validation passes. QA engineers would expect this element to be present on this screen.
